besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Both halves are full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'is eintlik twee ou woorde' is loose: the word is made of two parts, it is not two words.
besluite.rede: 'bestaan eintlik uit' says precisely what is meant, keeps the one-versus-two contrast and adds nothing.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die eerste deel is tele' and 'daardie deel beteken ver' each have subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: Same structure as the previous sentence; the comma is required and matches it.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Jy bly ... sit' and 'jy sien iets' are separate clauses with their own subject and verb.
'groot' and 'swaar' are of equal rank before the noun, so a comma belongs between them; meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: No comma after the long relative-clause subject, so 'gesien het was' runs two verbs together.
besluite.rede: The comma marks where the subject clause ends and makes the sentence easier to read at first sight.

besluite.fout: 'met 'n leer afklim' is not the Afrikaans expression and can read as climbing down while carrying a ladder.
besluite.rede: 'teen 'n leer afklim' is the fixed expression for the same action; the protected 'in lande met televisie' stays intact.

besluite.fout: 'manier van kommunikeer' is a stiff construction copied from English 'way of communicating'.
besluite.rede: 'manier om te kommunikeer' is the natural Afrikaans form with the same meaning.
